# name: The fathers of Hunahpu and Xbalanque; the lords of Xibalba
# title: Are chicut xchi ca biyh chic
# fols: fols. 12r–13r
Are chicut xchi ca biyh chic v bi qui cahau ri Hunahpu, Xbalanque. Xcacamuh chu vi, xa pu xcacamuh vbixic, vꜩihoxic puch qui ꜭaholaxic ri Hunahpu, Xbalanque; xa nicah xchi ca biyh, xa chacab v bixic qui cahau.

Vae cute vꜩihoxic. Are qui bi ri Hunhunahpu, que vꜭhaxic. Are cut qui cahau ri Xpiyacoc, Xmucane chique. Cumal chi acabal xe alaxic ri Hunhunahpu, Vvcub Hunahpu, cumal Xpiyacoc, Xmucane.

Are curi Hunhunahpu e caib xe ralcualah, e pu caib v ꜭahol: Hunbaꜩ vbi nabeal, Hunchouen chicut vbi vcabal. Are cut vbi qui chuch va Xbaquiyalo, chuꜭhaxic rixoquil Hunhunahpu. Are curi Vvcub Hunahpu mahabi rixoquil, xa vlaquel.

Xa pu v cab xa ꜭahol vꜭoheic, e nimac ahnaoh, nim puch quetamabal, e nicvachinel varal chuvach vleuh; xa vꜩ qui ꜭoheic, qui yaqueic puch. Xquicutu nauiquil chi qui vach ri Hunbaꜩ, Hunchouen, v ꜭahol Hunhunahpu: e ahzu, e ahbix, e ahpub, ahꜩibenai pu, ahcot, e ahxit, e ahpuvac xe vxic ri Hunbaꜩ, Hunchouen.

Are curi Hunhunahpu, Vcub Hunahpu xa zac, xa chaah chi qui bano hutaꜫih; xa e cacab chi qui culelaah quib, e cahib chi conohel ta que cuchmaihic pa hom.

Chul cu ri Voc ilol que, v zamahel Huracan, chi Chipi Caculha, Raxa Caculha. Are curi Voc mavi nah varal chuvach vleuh, mavi nah chi Xibalba; chire libahchi chopon chic chi cah ruꜭ Huracan.

Xe yaluh varal chuvach vleuh; xcaminac ca cut qui chuch ri Hunbaꜩ, Hunchouen. Are cut vbeel Xibalba xe chaah vi, ta xquita cut Huncame, Vvcub Came, rahaual Xibalba.

“Naqui pa ri caban chuvach vleuh? Xa que micnohic, xa pu que huminic. Quebe ta tacoc varal tah; que vl chaah vi, que ca chac ta cut. Xa mahabi canimaxic cumal, mahabi qui nim, ma pu habi qui xob cuxic; xax que hiquic vloc pa ca vi,” xe ꜭha cut conoh Xibalba.

Ta xqui cam qui naoh conohel ri qui bi Huncame, Vvcub Came, e nimac catol ꜩih. Are curi ahauab ronohel yaol v patan, rahauarem puch huhun chi ahauab rumal Huncame, Vvcub Came.

Are curi Xiquiripat, Cuchumaquic vbi ahau; are cut qui patan ri quic chu yabih vinac. Are chi curi Ahalpuh, Ahalꜫana chic qui ahauab. Are cut cahauarem ri chi zipohic vinac, chi pe puh chirih racan, chi pe ꜫana chirih vvach, Chuꜫanal chuꜭhaxic. Cate cut rahauarem Ahalpuh, Ahalꜫana vi.

Are chi curi ahau Chamiabac, Chamiaholom, rahchami Xibalba; xa bac qui chamiy. Are cut cahchamiyal ri chi baquir vinac, qui ꜩih chi bac, chi holom chic ta chi camic, ꜩiyah bac xu pan chi camouic. Are v patan vi Chamiyabac, Chamiyaholom qui bi.

Are chi curi ahau Ahalmez, Ahaltocob qui bi. Are qui patan vi xa chi culvachih vinac, vve ꜩamez, ve pe pu chirih ha, chuva ha, chi culvachix vi, xa chi qui tocota, chi be hupul oc chuvach vleuh, ta chi camic. Are cut cahauarem Ahalmez, Ahaltocob, que vꜭhaxic.

Are chi curi ahau Xic, Patan qui bi. Are cahauarem ri vinac chi cam pa be, xa rax camic chuꜭhaxic: chi pe quic pa chi, ta chi camic chu xavah quic. Xa huhun chi patan qui telelaon, xa chi qui cozih vculel vꜭux vinac ta chi cam pa be, xa chi qui culmah apon oc ve chibinic chi cul. Are cut cahauarem Xic, Patan vi.

Are cut xqui cuc qui naoh ri ta xe ꜩaixic, ta xe cotobax puch Hunhunahpu, Vvcub Hunahpu. Are xqui raih Xibalba ri queꜩabal Hunhunahpu, Vvcub Hunahpu, ri qui ꜩuun, qui bate, qui pachcab, qui yachvach, vachzot puch, qui cauubal Hunhunahpu, Vvcub Hunahpu.

Are chicut xchi ca biyh chic qui biye chi Xibalba. Xe canah cu canoc ri Hunbaꜩ, Chouen, v ꜭahol Hunhunahpu. Xcaminac oc qui chuch; ca chuvi chic qui chacatahic chic Hunbaꜩ, Hunchouen cumal Hunahpu, Xbalanque.
